llm_turns.content:
Walking is the pragmatic choice here; at just 50 meters, starting an engine adds unnecessary fuel consumption and wear without saving time. Unless you are currently stuck in a rush where every second counts more than the extra thirty seconds of walking, your feet will get you there faster than the keys to the ignition.

**Why:** The energy cost of driving for such a short distance outweighs any convenience gained from not walking, and the delay in starting the car often negates the time saved by being seated.
